statement: Every ratified row of spec/core.md is accounted for below with the reason its row class is not statistical. All figures are predicted-model tool results; nothing here implies fabrication or measurement.
voided_by: Adding any accuracy, offset, matching, yield, Cpk or sigma row to spec/core.md voids this statement; that row needs klt yield evidence.

rows.reason: A pinned upstream commit and file hashes (reuse.lock.json, decision 0007); the row names an exact source, not a measured quantity.
A pinned cell-library revision and flavour (decision 0001); the row names an exact artifact, not a measured quantity.
A static timing result at the SS Liberty corner named in spec/core.md (STA corner set); the characterised corner files bound the result and there is no sampled variation. Reported as predicted.
A rule-check verdict on one GDS against a content-hash-pinned deck (decision 0005); the same inputs always give the same verdict.
A netlist-match verdict on one layout against a pinned cell CDL and deck hash (decision 0005); the same inputs always give the same verdict.
